# Formatho

> Privacy-first developer tools that run 100% client-side in your browser. Free forever, no sign-up, zero tracking. Nothing you enter is uploaded, logged, or stored.

Every tool page states what the tool does, how to use it step by step, and answers common questions. Free, private, runs in your browser.

## Tools

### Security & Auth

- [TLS Certificate Checker]: https://formatho.com/tools/tls-checker — Check TLS/SSL certificate expiry, issuer, and security configuration. Paste openssl output for instant analysis.
- [SOC 2 Readiness Checklist]: https://formatho.com/tools/soc2-checklist — Interactive checklist covering all 5 Trust Service Criteria with linked tools for each control.
- [Security Policy Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/policy-generator — Generate password, access control, and incident response policies for SOC 2 compliance.
- [Security Headers Analyzer]: https://formatho.com/tools/security-headers — Check HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options and more on any URL. Graded A-F with fix recommendations.
- [CSP Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/csp-generator — Build Content-Security-Policy headers visually. Configure directives and copy the header.
- [CSP Evaluator]: https://formatho.com/tools/csp-evaluator — Analyze a CSP header for weaknesses: unsafe-inline, wildcards, missing directives, bypass risks.
- [CORS Tester]: https://formatho.com/tools/cors-tester — Test cross-origin requests from your browser. See Access-Control-Allow-Origin, methods and headers.
- [Cookie Security Analyzer]: https://formatho.com/tools/cookie-analyzer — Check Set-Cookie headers for Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite, prefixes and domain scope.
- [JWT & Auth Toolkit]: https://formatho.com/tools/jwt-suite — Complete auth debugging suite: decode and verify JWTs, inspect claims, build OIDC URLs, decode SAML, generate tokens. All client-side.
- [SAML Request & Response Decoder]: https://formatho.com/tools/saml-decoder — Decode SAML AuthnRequest and Response messages - base64 plus raw-deflate - with pretty-printed XML. Essential for Okta, Entra ID and Shibboleth debugging. 100% client-side.
- [OIDC Authorization URL & PKCE Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/oidc-url-builder — Build OAuth 2.0 / OIDC authorize URLs with state, nonce and S256 PKCE code challenges. Works with Okta, Auth0, Entra ID, Keycloak.
- [JWT Debugger]: https://formatho.com/tools/jwt — Decode and inspect JWT tokens instantly.
- [Hash Text]: https://formatho.com/tools/hash-text — Generate Argon2id, bcrypt, PBKDF2, MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, BLAKE2b, and Poseidon hashes online. 100% client-side Argon2id password hashing for maximum security.
- [Bcrypt]: https://formatho.com/tools/bcrypt — Generate and verify Bcrypt password hashes.
- [Encrypt/Decrypt]: https://formatho.com/tools/encryption — Encrypt and decrypt text using various algorithms.
- [HMAC Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/hmac-generator — Generate HMAC hash codes with various algorithms.
- [RSA Key Pair]: https://formatho.com/tools/rsa-key-pair-generator — Generate RSA public/private key pairs.
- [Password Strength]: https://formatho.com/tools/password-strength-analyser — Analyze password strength and get improvement suggestions.
- [TOTP Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/otp-code-generator — Generate TOTP codes from secrets. Privacy-first tool.
- [PDF Signature Checker]: https://formatho.com/tools/pdf-signature-checker — Check and validate digital signatures in PDF files. Privacy-first tool.
- [Token Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/token-generator — Generate secure random tokens with customizable length and character sets.
- [Basic Auth Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/basic-auth-generator — Generate HTTP Basic Authentication headers.
- [String Obfuscator]: https://formatho.com/tools/string-obfuscator — Obfuscate strings to hide sensitive data.
